name: Episil-Precision Inc.
summary: Episil-Precision Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of silicon epitaxy wafers and compound semiconductor epitaxial wafers in Taiwan, Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers buried-layer epitaxy wafers, multi-layer epitaxy wafers, silicon epitaxy on SOI (silicon on insulator) wafers, GaN epitaxial wafers, and silicon carbide (SiC) epitaxial wafers for power semiconductors, such as power MOSFET, diodes, insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT), and power Managements IC (PMIC) applications.
